{{Quote|&mdash;And all of those credits are there for the ''taking'', Han&hellip; I'm ''telling'' you&mdash;we hit the Empire's acquisitions and processing center on our way out of here and we're set for ''life''.|Billal Batross|<ref name="HollowMoon" />}}
'''Moog Mot VI''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Bank/Legends|banking]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]. It hosted a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Moog Mot VI Imperial garrison|garrison]], where Imperial [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] at one point mined the [[Datacore/Legends|data core]] of the [[Sollima's chief accounting droid|chief accounting droid]] of [[Sollima]]&mdash;a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] from whom the Empire wanted to wrest control over the [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as the [[Hollow Moon]].

Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Sollima forced the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to team up with his former [[Thief/Legends|thieving]] partner [[Billal Batross]] in order to [[Mission to Moog Mot VI|retrieve]] the [[3D-4X administrative droid|accounting droid]] from the Empire. The pair traveled to Moog Mot IV, where they infiltrated the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] by posing as [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and succeeded in locating the [[Administrative droid/Legends|droid]]. However, Batross, on whom the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] held incriminating information, destroyed it, and he and Solo were subsequently captured and interrogated by the Empire. In turn, the garrison's [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Taavin]] then forced the pair to betray Sollima and help the Empire [[Takeover of the Hollow Moon|take over]] the Hollow Moon, and Solo and Batross subsequently departed from Moog Mot VI on their new assignment to the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station.

==Description==
Moog Mot VI was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] that occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="HollowMoon" /> in the [[Moog Mot system/Legends|Moog Mot system]], a part of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC MoogMot" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA MoogMot" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="HollowMoon" /> It was situated on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Dennogra system/Legends|Dennogra]] and [[Taskeed system/Legends|Taskeed systems]].<ref name="TEA MoogMot" /> Moog Mot VI had [[Color/Legends|reddish]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]] and a red-colored rocky surface.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

==History==
===A stolen droid===
{{Quote|So instead ''[the Imperials have]'' stolen my chief accounting droid and are mining its data core for information to use against me. You retrieve and return this droid to me&mdash;''intact''&mdash;and all between us will be forgiven, Solo.|Sollima|<ref name="HollowMoon" />}}
[[File:SollimasAccountingDroid-HollowMoonOfKhorya.jpg|thumb|left|300px|On Moog Mot VI, the Galactic Empire mined the data core of Sollima's chief accounting droid.]]
[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] before<ref name="HollowMoon" /> [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBYStradley">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?p=222830&sid=634e9537b4a0efac4e276071c9f94f27|thread=SW Adventures - Han Solo and the Hollow Moon...|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|date=2009-03-25|time=12:29|quote=The script said two years before, but [[Leland Chee|Leland]] said to place it at one year before. Unfortunately, the script didn't get changed.}} &mdash; [[Randy Stradley]]'s comments on the discrepancy of ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya]]'' dating its events to both approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] put into motion plans to gain control over the [[Hollow Moon]],<ref name="HollowMoon" /> a [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="EAOC Khorya">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Khorya system/Legends|Khorya system]]</ref> [[Sollima's gambling network|gambling]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] run by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sollima]]. To that end, the Empire purchased Sollima's [[Sollima's chief accounting droid|principal accounting droid]] from [[Billal Batross]], a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] who was in debt to the gangster and wanted to dispose of the [[3D-4X administrative droid|droid]] since it was aware of him stealing [[Currency/Legends|money]] from Sollima. The Empire stored the partially disassembled [[Administrative droid/Legends|accounting droid]]&mdash;which Sollima believed the Empire had stolen&mdash;at the [[Moog Mot VI Imperial garrison|Imperial garrison]] on Moog Mot VI, where [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] mined its [[Datacore/Legends|data core]] in order to obtain information that would prove useful against Sollima.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

Around 1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="1BBYStradley" /> Sollima captured on the<ref name="HollowMoon" /> [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]]<ref name="EAOC Simbarc">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Simbarc system/Legends|Simbarc system]]</ref> planet [[Simbarc]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], a pair of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who were also indebted to the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]]. Upon the suggestion of Batross, who was a former thieving partner of Solo's, Sollima tasked the latter with traveling to Moog Mot VI and [[Mission to Moog Mot VI|retrieving]] his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] from the Empire. In addition, since Sollima decided to keep Chewbacca hostage in order to ensure that he and his partner would not simply flee after being released, and since Solo still needed a [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]] for the mission, he was paired up with Batross. Solo and Batross then left Simbarc for Moog Mot VI aboard the former's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="HollowMoon" />

===Mission to an Imperial garrison===
{{Quote|We know why Sollima sent you and what you were after. We know everything.|Captain Taavin, to Han Solo|<ref name="HollowMoon" />}}
[[File:Moog_Mot_VI_Imperial_Garrison.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Han Solo and Billal Batross infiltrated the Imperial garrison on Moog Mot VI in order to retrieve Sollima's droid.]]
After the [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter]] emerged into [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] at the Imperial [[Bank/Legends|banking]] world, it transmitted to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] a falsified landing code provided by Sollima. Donning fake [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial uniforms]] as disguises, Solo and Batross subsequently entered the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. There, the former used [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] schematics of the facility to locate the room where Sollima's droid was being kept while Batross was deliberating on robbing the Empire's [[acquisitions and processing center]] and making off with a large number of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Entering the room without the necessary clearance code, Solo knocked out the [[Unidentified technician|technician]] working on the droid and then tasked Batross with disconnecting the automaton from the wiring that had been plugged into it while he dragged the unconscious technician away.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

[[File:SoloBatrossTheft-HollowMoonOfKhorya.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Solo and Batross attempt to steal Sollima's droid from the Moog Mot VI garrison.]]
However, Batross, who was intent on hiding the tracks of his theft from Sollima, then shot the droid's head, angering Solo because Sollima had wanted the droid intact, and Batross's actions thus put the captive Chewbacca's life in danger. When Batross subsequently did disconnect the wires from the droid, an alarm was triggered, forcing the pair to grab the droid's disassembled parts and flee the room. The would-be thieves quickly ran into a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] patrol, to whom Batross immediately surrendered. The pair was then arrested and taken away for interrogation under [[Torture/Legends|torture]].<ref name="HollowMoon" />

When Batross divulged to Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Taavin]] the details of his and Solo's mission, the captain liberated the pair and offered them a choice between standing trial for [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] and [[Treason/Legends|treason]] or returning the droid's remains to Sollima at the Hollow Moon and then overriding the station's security codes, thereby allowing the Empire to [[Takeover of the Hollow Moon|take over]] the gambling establishment. Solo and Batross accepted Taavin's latter offer and boarded the ''Millennium Falcon'', departing from Moog Mot VI for the Hollow Moon.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Wha&mdash;?! How did you get in here? What's your clearance code?|An Imperial technician, to Han Solo|<ref name="HollowMoon" />}}
Moog Mot VI was a banking world controlled by the Galactic Empire, with three Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] patrolling in its orbit. The Imperial garrison on Moog Mot VI was staffed by several [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]&ndash;[[Language/Legends|speaking]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] and technicians as well as stormtroopers. The facility's crew also included a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] and several [[MSE-series|mouse droids]].<ref name="HollowMoon" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|We're getting close.|Han Solo, upon viewing the schematics for the Imperial garrison|<ref name="HollowMoon" />}}
Moog Mot VI had on its surface a Galactic Empire garrison, which included two towering dark metallic structures. The Imperial installations on the world also featured an acquisitions and processing center as well as a room outfitted with torture equipment.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moog Mot VI first appeared in [[Star Wars Adventures: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya|''Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya'']], the first entry in [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series of graphic novellas. ''Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya'' was written by [[Jeremy Barlow]], pencilled by [[Rick Lacy]],<ref name="HollowMoon" /> and published on [[April 29]], [[2009]].<ref name="HollowMoonDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/15-577/Star-Wars-Adventures-Volume-1-Han-Solo-and-the-Hollow-Moon-of-Khorya-TPB|text=Star Wars Adventures Volume 1: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya TPB}}</ref> The [[August 18]], 2009<ref name="TEADate">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Moog Mot [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Moog Mot VI, in grid square S-8.<ref name="TEA MoogMot" />
